objective: Implement PRD-defined input ingestion, attribution, normalization, redaction, persistence, and provenance capture.
implemented_behaviors: Mapped attribution.agent_authors list entries with login fields now match actor.login, author.login, actor, and author values for bot-login attribution.
Missing or invalid attribution.uncertain now defaults to exclude so ambiguous events are skipped instead of persisted.
Corrupt existing .relia/experiences JSONL shards now return provenance_integrity_failed with exit 9 instead of artifact contract exit 4.
Focused red-first tests reproduced the three Codex review findings before implementation and passed after repair.

findings.finding: Read login values from mapped attribution.agent_authors entries for bot-login attribution.
Default missing or invalid attribution.uncertain to exclude.
Use exit 9 for corrupt existing experience shards.
